description: List all 24 trivia categories available in the Open Trivia Database with their numeric IDs. Categories include General Knowledge (9), Entertainment: Books (10), Film (11), Music (12), Musicals & Theatres (13), Television (14), Video Games (15), Board Games (16), Science & Nature (17), Computers (18), Mathematics (19), Mythology (20), Sports (21), Geography (22), History (23), Politics (24), Art (25), Celebrities (26), Animals (27), Vehicles (28), Comics (29), Gadgets (30), Japanese Anime & Manga (31), Cartoon & Animations (32). Use returned IDs as the 'category' parameter in opentdb.trivia.questions. Source: opentdb.com — CC BY-SA 4.0, free unlimited.
